notes: Seeded from a research pass on 12 Oct 2026. Every listing URL was tested with scripts/page_text.py; 'readable' records the result (ok / js-only / refused / failed).

Community covers markets and fairs, public workshops and classes, family events, park and outdoor events, sport to watch, local talks and meetings, volunteering, library events, festivals and fetes, heritage walks and open studios. Music nights, arts/theatre/exhibitions, food special events and health & wellness events (runs and races you join, fitness, yoga, sound baths, sauna, meditation, Qi Gong) belong to other scouts: skip them here even when a venue below lists them (e.g. Oxford House Friday Jazz, St John on Bethnal Green concerts, All Points East).

Several entries are confirmed open only by a current page with a regular schedule and no dated one-off 2026 event (council street markets, Hackney City Farm, Stepney City Farm). Their status_evidence says so; the verifier should not treat those as proof of any particular date.

Where the venue's own page and the council's page disagree on market hours (Columbia Road: own site 'Sundays from 8am ’til 3'ish', council '8am to 2pm'), quote the venue's own page and mention the difference in the listing.

Fixed 13 Oct 2026: page_text.py and check_quote.py now check robots.txt and the never-use list on every redirect, so romanroadlondon.com/events/ (which redirects to towerhamletsslice.co.uk) is refused. Both domains stay do-not-scrape.
Scouts may read this file but must not edit it. Suggested changes go in the run report for a human to apply.
A venue with no_primary_listing: true has no venue or ticket page online; the verifier may publish its events on aggregator evidence alone (medium confidence at most).

Platform 'domains' are enforced by scripts/validate.py and scripts/check_quote.py: do-not-use and do-not-scrape domains are never fetched or accepted as evidence; discovery-only domains can never be labelled primary. Note these domain lists are merged across every registry in data/sources/.

zones.core: E2 postcode or within about 1km of Bethnal Green tube. Scanned every run.
zones.fringe: Up to about a 20-minute walk (1.6km) from Bethnal Green tube (Hackney Road, Cambridge Heath, Columbia Road, Haggerston, Brick Lane, Whitechapel, Mile End, Victoria Park). Scanned every run.
zones.outer: Further out (Spitalfields, Hackney Wick, Hackney Central, Stratford edge). Scanned weekly, standout events only, max 5 candidates per run, flagged worth_the_trip.

platforms.name: Resident Advisor (ra.co)
platforms.why: No public API. Terms 4.4 ban automated extraction without written permission; robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot. Do not fetch, do not use third-party RA scrapers.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.how: Not fetched by agents. Events seen there arrive as reader tips or manual entries.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.how: Not fetched by agents (login wall, terms). Several parks and markets (e.g. Victoria Park, Columbia Road) announce events there; those arrive as reader tips or manual entries.

platforms.name: Venue or organiser's own website
platforms.how: Read the page given in the venue's listing with scripts/page_text.py. A page stating a regular schedule counts as a primary source for that schedule.

platforms.name: Tower Hamlets Council (events calendar, parks, markets)
platforms.how: Events.aspx lists dated events with Date and Location, filterable by category (Victoria Park, Parks, Markets, Libraries and literature, Family and children, Volunteering, Sports and exercise, Heritage and museums, Festivals...). Each event has its own page under /News_events/Events/<year>/<Month>/ with 'Date(s)' and 'Location'. RSS and Atom feeds are offered on the page. Community-submitted listings: confirm on the organiser's page where one exists.

platforms.name: Hackney Council events
platforms.how: hackney.gov.uk/events renders with JavaScript: page_text.py returned only the footer. Not usable by scouts until a readable feed is found.

platforms.name: Ticket Tailor
platforms.how: Read public box-office pages, e.g. tickettailor.com/events/<box-office>. Event list shows title, date/time and room/address.

platforms.name: Eventbrite
platforms.how: Location search was shut off in 2020. Only list events by organiser or venue id stored on a venue below. Key in env EVENTBRITE_TOKEN. The public browse page (eventbrite.co.uk/b/united-kingdom--london/community/) is readable but London-wide, so use it for leads only.

platforms.name: A Church Near You (Church of England)
platforms.how: Church event pages carry JSON-LD Event data (start/end times) that page_text.py prints. Use the church's /service-and-events/ page.

platforms.name: Boxing promoters' own news pages
platforms.how: York Hall has no venue event listing; fight nights are announced by promoters. Read the promoter's own announcement (Matchroom tested ok; Queensberry not yet tested).

platforms.name: ma.to
platforms.how: Has event pages for some markets (e.g. Victoria Park Market). Leads only; confirm on a primary page where one exists.

platforms.name: Time Out London
platforms.how: Things-to-do and kids pages readable. Leads only.

platforms.name: GoodGym
platforms.how: Lists volunteering sessions (e.g. Weavers Adventure Playground, Mile End parkrun). Area page is thin; leads only.

platforms.name: parkrun
platforms.how: parkrun.org.uk answered HTTP 403 to our fetcher on 12 Oct 2026; stop on 403. Parkrun events arrive as reader tips or manual entries.

platforms.name: Tower Hamlets Slice / Roman Road LDN
platforms.how: towerhamletsslice.co.uk robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot. romanroadlondon.com redirects there. Do not fetch; a person may read it for leads.

platforms.name: The Restart Project (repair events)
platforms.how: robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot. Repair cafés are covered via St Margaret's House's own page.

platforms.name: ianVisits
platforms.how: robots.txt disallows anthropic-ai. Good for talks and heritage events, but people only.
